notes.title: Major Issue Update
notes.content:
A lot of English speaking players has informed me about the grammar of the English localization of Summer Crush.
They all agreed that localization has been somewhat broken. The good news is that I already had sent it for correcting by a professional translator. So, expect a patch. 

Also, the size of the game was very large. As they wrote on a well-known website, it's time to convert PNG format to JPEG so that we can achieve a much more significant reduction of package size of the VN but also make sure that the quality of the images are still top-notch. Now, thanks to my friend etcroot from this problem we got rid of. 

A patch should be deployed in a few days (assuming that the translation will be fixed in time), so stay tuned.

notes.title: Today Is the Day!
notes.content:
November 25 is the 329th day in the Gregorian calendar. On this day, Albert Einstein presented the field equations of general relativity to the Prussian Academy of Sciences, the "Hollywood Ten" were blacklisted during the Red Scare, and Lee Harvey Oswalks was buried in Fort Worth, Texas. Famous birthdays include John F. Kennedy Jr., Christina Applegate, and Andrew Carnegie. November 25 also marks International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women.

And also...

Summer Crush is finally out!

There are a bunch of girls in one unnamed town who don't mind getting to know you better at all! Which one will you choose?
